claim_text: OPEC+ kept November oil production targets steady while effective Gulf output remained below quota.
support_excerpt: Reuters reported unchanged November targets and output below quota.
data_boundary: August output figures are lagged and not October actuals.

claim_text: Middle East crude exports reached or exceeded pre-war levels on several late-September days while attacks on vessels increased.
source_name: Reuters Middle East exports and tanker attacks
support_excerpt: Kpler shipping data and maritime-security reporting cited by Reuters.
data_boundary: Shipping estimates can omit dark transits; attack frequency does not equal cargo loss.

claim_text: Iran tied normalized Strait of Hormuz reopening to seven conditions in its negotiating position.
support_excerpt: Reuters reported Iran's public negotiating position on reopening.
data_boundary: This is a negotiating position and does not mean zero commercial transits.

claim_text: G7 reserve releases and recovering Middle East exports reduced near-term oil supply anxiety while security risks persisted.
support_excerpt: Reuters reported intraday Brent/WTI declines alongside G7 reserve release and export recovery.
data_boundary: Intraday price only; not full-day settlement.
